# Skeleton
Atlas Skeleton v1 — a placeholder block shown where content is still loading. 1 property: Shape rect | circle (2 total). rect is a rounded block (radius/md), circle is a round one (radius/full, for avatars). Fill is background-muted. A skeleton has no fixed size: it fills its container's width and takes its height from the layout (default 16, spacing/4; circle 40, spacing/10).

When to use: content whose final shape is known and that loads in under a few seconds (a list row, a card, a form, a table). Compose several blocks into the layout you are waiting for.
When not to use: for an unknown wait with no layout (use Spinner), for a known percentage (use Progress), or for empty or error states.

Motion: a pulse. Opacity goes from 1 down to opacity/pulse (0.5) and back over duration/pulse (2000ms) with easing/standard, looping. Under prefers-reduced-motion the pulse stops and the block stays static.

Accessibility: the block is aria-hidden and has no role. The loading container sets aria-busy=true and owns any announcement. No hover, focus, active or disabled state.
